quests.title: Prove Yourself
quests.text: Hmm... First, you need to prove yourself. Go outside of town and capture your 1st monster! The forest west of here would be a good place. You only get one chance per monster, so you need to lower its health in order to better your chances.

quests.title: Defeat 10 Monsters
quests.text: Go defeat 10 monsters. By the time you come back to me, you will be ready to face real challenges. I forgot to mention this earlier but you can take up to 3 quest with you at any given time.

quests.title: Beat Rigel
quests.text: Rigel is a local breeder hostile to the guild. Defeat him and claim your reward. He is to be found somewhere in the North Cave.

quests.title: Beat Barbarian
quests.text: There are reports of travelers getting attacked by a barbarian deep in the forest to the west. Go neutralize the threat and come back.

quests.title: Deliver Message
quests.text: You need to deliver this message to the guild in Westguard. Just travel north to Northern Alvalon and you will see the city of Westguard. You must defeat a Dragon Overlord that is blocking the way first.

quests.title: Evolution
quests.text: Some monsters will evolve after gaining enough levels. Evolving your monsters is a big task for breeders. Show us that you and your monsters are capable of this.

quests.title: Clear North Cave
quests.text: The Guild's excavation team wants to dig up some monster fossils in the North Cave. Your task is to Defeat all monsters on Floor 1 through 2 to ensure the team can work in a safe enviroment.

quests.title: Spirited Away
quests.text: Spirit totems are powerful tools to own. Find the creature known as Resistance in the bottom of the cave to the north nad get 1 totem from it.

quests.title: Recipe For Creation
quests.text: If you defeat a breeder named ivo on the beach to the north, he will give you a recipe. You can use it to combine 2 monsters into something new. Combine Bitewing with Wolf 1 time.

towns.about: Corova is the Town the Player starts in.

towns.name: Dundean
towns.about: Dundean is a town located in Safaris.

quests.title: Name
quests.text: Description

quests.title: Defeat The Guild
quests.text: Attack the guilds in Westguard, Longdale, Olympia and liberate the cities. You need to do this by yourself with no assistance. We can't march into cities with a full army. It needs to be a one man mission so no civilian casualties are suffered.

towns.name: Longdale

quests.title: Dwarf King
quests.text: Alvis was recently acclaimed the King of Dwarves in the woods southwest of here. It is not legitimate and we cannot allow this to continue.

quests.title: Barbarian Alert
quests.text: Follow the river south from here. A barbarian has been sighted in the forest on the west bank.

quests.title: Body Guard
quests.text: An unknown breeder is blocking the mountain path north of the cave. Travel past the cave entrance and head norht into the forest.

quests.title: Dangerous Experiment
quests.text:
A breeder has accumulated a dangerous amount of explosive materials. Find him far south of here, on the other side of the river near the mountains. Cross the bridge in Endergate and head west following the river.

Battle Rabi @ South x past the blah

Turtle King x10, Blood Rogue + 2?

* note, Turtle Kings explode a lot.

Settlement

quests.title: Boyd
quests.text: A well-known breeder called Boyd has recently been openly critical of the Guild. Find him in the Cave of Earlsome.

quests.title: Ghosts
quests.text: Travel east from here. Some locals have spotted ghosts on the road running along the river.

quests.title: Yacare
quests.text: Travel east from here along the river, follow the road leading north and travel through the forest. There is a breeder there who we need you to take care of.

quests.title: Private Army
quests.text: Swinedene's fjord area is currently being occupied by breeders hostile to the Guild. Guy is one of them. Travel east to Endergate and then turn north to find him.

quests.title: Omar
quests.text: Another target for you in Swinedene's fjord area. Travel north to North Earlsome and head east.

towns.about: Longdale is a town in South Earlsome. This town has the most quests of any town in the game with 24.

towns.name: Lorensia

quests.title: Stop Clematis
quests.text: A breeder named Clematis is building a private cavalry of mounted monsters in the forest southeast of Eastern Gracia. She has no authorization to do such a thing.

quests.title: Pirate Ship
quests.text: Our scouts have spooted a Pirate Ship headed toward the beach south of Lorensia. We don't want any pirates landing at Gracia. We rely on you to protect the land.

towns.about: Lorensia is a city located in Western Gracia.

towns.name: Olympia

quests.title: Enya
quests.text: Enya has turned against us. She is right outside of Olympia, blocking all our activities. We need you to defeat her.

quests.title: Hunter
quests.text: There have been reprots of illegal hunting activities in the forest to the north of the city, across the strait. Go arrest the illegal hunter.

quests.title: Death Crawler
quests.text: Death Crawlers gain strength for every monster that they defeat. There is a hostile breeder on the south side of the river in Saintspring that has a powerful Death Crawler. Go defeat him before it's too late.

towns.about: Olympia is a town located in Applefield .

quests.title: Soulstone
quests.text: A monster's soul can be taken out and given to other monsters. It may seem cruel, but it's something a breeder must do. Create a soulstone and come back to me.

quests.title: Capture Baby Nessie
quests.text: The guild needs a sample of Baby Nessie to run some test on. Catch 1 and come back. There haven't been any reported sightings in Northern Alvalon for over a decade. You may want to try the Beach in Southern Alvalon.

quests.title: Ant Swarm
quests.text: We have work for you. A swarm of Giant Ants has been blocking the passage on the road southwest of Westguard. Go clean up the mess.

quests.title: Northern Passage
quests.text: A Breeder hostile to the Guild is blocking the passage leading north from Westguard. The Northern passage is vital for trade. Go clear it.

quests.title: Barbarian Sighted
quests.text: Hunters have been attacked by a barbarian in the forest directly west of here. Go check it out.

quests.title: Beat Fiona
quests.text: Fiona is a breeder hostile to the Guild. She and her partner, Mazarine, have been interrumpting the Guild's research missions in the cave southwest from here. We need you to defeat her.

quests.title: Beat Mazarine
quests.text: Mazarine is a breeder hostile to the Guild. She and her partner, Fiona, have been interrumpting the Guild's research missions in the cave southwest from here. We need you to defeat her as well.

quests.title: Deliver Message
quests.text: You need to deliver this message to the Guild in Dundean. Travel north to Ringfeld and take the path headed east. There is a powerful Dragon guarding the path. Beware.

quests.title: Rescue Adina
quests.text: A young girl named Adina has been missing from her home for the last couple of days. Some people in the city saw her walking towards the lighthouse in the North. She may be in trouble. Go rescue her.

quests.title: Defeat Carmin
quests.text: One of the breeders on a mission to capture a White Dolphin in the lighthouse has not returned. We supplied him with a powerful lineup of monsters for the job and he may have walked away with it.

specials.10: Waypoint; Lulu (team: Iron King and two Orochis, all lvl 84) gives you Iron King Recipe / Evil (spirit)

dungeons.about: Unknown Relic is a dungeon that leads to the Underworld. It remains locked (you can pass over it, but can't enter the dungeon) until you complete the Final Battle quest in Olympia .

overlords.about: In Buddhist mythology, Apalala is a water-dwelling dragon who lived near the Swat River. He was converted to Buddhism by the Buddha;this is one of the most popular legends in Buddhist lore and art. The tale is often told to Buddhist children for them to learn their happiness lies in their faith.

overlords.about: Ladon (Greek: Λάδων; gen.: Λάδωνος) was the serpent-like dragon that twined and twisted around the tree in the Garden of the Hesperides and guarded the golden apples. He was overcome by Heracles.

Beat Barbarian.text: There are reports of travelers getting attacked by a barbarian deep in the forest to the west. Go neutralize the threat and come back.

Beat Rigel.text: Rigel is a local breeder hostile to the guild. Defeat him and claim your reward. He is to be found somewhere in the North Cave.
Beat Rigel.how: To complete this quest, you'll have to go up into the North Cave dungeon in Southern Alvalon. Rigel is located on floor 1. Rigel's Team: 1 Bitewing 2 Bitewing 3 Bitewing 4 Cockatrice
Beat Rigel.reward: 257 Silver (may not be exactly the same every time). [[Category:Corova Quests]]

Ant Swarm.text: We have work for you. A swarm of Giant Ants has been blocking the passage on the road southwest of Westguard. Go clean up the mess.
Ant Swarm.how: To complete this quest, go to the location shown below: {| border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" class="article-table article-table-selected" ! scope="col"| |} Here, you'll get in a fight with a group of 10 Giant Ants. You'll need to kill them.

Barbarian Sighted.text: Hunters have been attacked by a barbarian in the forest directly west of here. Go check it out.
Barbarian Sighted.how: The NPC you'll need to fight, Cyrus, is located here: {| border="0" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" class="article-table" ! scope="col"| |} Defeat him to complete the quest. His team is: 1 Flame Wing 2 Fairy Queen 3 Flame Wing 4 Fire Cub 5 Snow Cub 6 Slime
Barbarian Sighted.reward: Oval Gem (+30 Defense) - Stats may vary each time. [[Category:Westguard Quests]]

Beat Fiona.text: Fiona is a breeder hostile to the Guild. She and her partner, Mazarine, have been interrupting the Guild's research missions in the cave southwest from here. We need you to defeat her.
Beat Fiona.how: You'll need to find Fiona in the Pirate's Cave dungeon and defeat her to complete the quest. Fiona is located on floor 4. She'll fight you with this team: 1 Flame Wing 2 Flame Wing 3 Flame Wing 4 Wasp Queen

Beat Mazarine.text: Mazarine is a breeder hostile to the Guild. She and her partner, Fiona, have been interrupting the Guild's research missions in a cave southwest of here. We need you to defeat her as well.
Beat Mazarine.how: You'll need to go into Pirate's Cave and defeat Mazarine to complete this quest. Mazarine is located on floor 5. Her team is: 1 Mer Hunter 2 Mer Hunter 3 Mer Hunter 4 Kingpen

Arrest Kai.obtained: Longdale. After taking Head to Olympia (Quest).
Arrest Kai.text: Our hunters have trapped a dangerous breeder called Kai in thevalley of Swinedene but that is all that they can manage. Kai's army of Samurais have been keeping our hunters from closing in
Arrest Kai.how: You will find Kai and his army at the lighthouse spot in Swinedene. The lighthouse isn't a dungeon entrance, you will be attacked as soon as you take the step there with this quest on you. Respond in kind. His army consists of 3 Ninja, 10 Samurai Lord and 3 Shogun
Arrest Kai.reward: 2541 silver. Exact ammount appears to be level based as other users reported larger ammounts.

Arrest Iris.text: A political activist named Iris is taking shelter in the Cave of Endergate. She is known for causing trouble, but lately she has gone overboard. We have no choice but to arrest her
Arrest Iris.how: You've met Iris before. This time She's on the 3rd floor of the Cave of Endergate trying to find a peaceful place to live..ugh..tough luck girl. She has 2 Snake God, onopposite sides of a Spike Monster, followed by Megaslug, 2 Snake God, Tengu, Megaslug, Tengu, 2 Spikey, Iron Slime, and a King Slime
Arrest Iris.reward: After the fight you can pick up her chest with a round emerald, 51 magic. The guild will reward you with 20 gold.

Arrest Cyrus.text: Your target is a barbarian called Cyrus. He has been causing a lot of trouble all over the island. We have no choice but to arrest him.
Arrest Cyrus.how: Exit Olympia (or cross the bridge to get on the small island it's on) and head 2 steps through the forests north of the city. Good old "barbarian" Cyrus will be surprised to meet you on that spot. Monsters to expect with him: Yacare[Spike Monster]], Fire Tiger, Lion King, Spike Monster, Orochi, Lion King, 2 Wolf God, 3 Yacare

Arrest Gladstone.text: Gladstone is an extremist who is threatening to attack the Guild if we do not suspend our operations in the Sanctuary; the nest of all anti-guild movements. Arrest him. He is somewhere in Saintspring.
Arrest Gladstone.how: Go to the spot 2 steps the bridge in Saintspring and head straight east (right). You will be attacked by Gladstone when you reach the shore. You know what to do then. Note: You may notice Gladstone seems to be a step north from the spot where you find the target of the next quest - Duncan. Unfortunately it's not possible to jump from on spot to the other, the game forces you to take the path starting from the road. The cliff-face path to Duncan is separate from the one to Gladstone (see picture)

Clear North Cave.text: The Guild's excavation team wants to dig up some monster fossils in the North Cave. Your task is to defeat all monsters on floor 1 through 2 to ensure the team can work in a safe environment.
Clear North Cave.how: To complete this quest, you will have to kill every monster on floors 1 and 2 of North Cave. Upon fully clearing any floor, a message will inform you of such. Then you can move on to the next floor.

Capture Baby Nessie.text: The guild needs a sample of Baby Nessie to run some test on. Catch 1 and come back. There haven't been any reported sightings in Northern Alvalon fo over a decade. You may want to try the Beach in Southern Alvalon.
Capture Baby Nessie.how: To complete this quest, capture a Baby Nessie! Check the Baby Nessie page for location information.

Collector.obtained: Southern Alvalon from the Old Sage.
Collector.how: To complete this quest, simply complete the other three collection quests from the Old Sage.

Boyd.obtained: Longdale. Next quest after Private Army
Boyd.text: A well-known breeder called Boyd has recently openly critical of the Guild. Find him in the Cave of Earlsome
Boyd.how: [needs typing in] [information what monsters Boyd has goes here, I can't remember anymore sorry]

Bounty Hunt.text: We have a bounty hunt for you. Travel east to Endergate and follow the road heading south. Your target is Urusula, a dangerous breeder that has attacked civilians in the past.
Bounty Hunt.how: If you follow the road south in Endergate Urusula will ambush you right where the road branches off to the entrance of the Cave of Endergate. Monsters to expect: Morfeus, Megaslug, Beholder, Lich King, Imp, 2 x Morfeus, Skull_Crow, 2 x Megaslug, Dream Hunter, Megaslug, Dream Hunter, 3 x Angelic Bird. In that order.

Bounty Hunt (Longdale 2nd).text: We can share no details on this one, but your target is a breeder called Mazarine. You should be able to find her in the Cave of Endergate.
Bounty Hunt (Longdale 2nd).how: Just to remind you - Endergate is the area to the east (right) of Longdale. Cross the bridge and enter the cave there. You'll find Mazarine on the 11th floor. Monsters to expect: Mer King, Crab King, Terror Shark, Ceola King, Sea Caliph, Dark Razorfish, Sea Dragon, 2 Turtle Kings and 3 Don Penguinis. Note those are all water creatures, so Air monsters are your best bet. It's also a good idea to take monsters that can attack multiple targets at once and kill the last 2 or 3 Don Penguinis before k
Bounty Hunt (Longdale 2nd).reward: 2483 silver (exact ammount may vary depending on level)

Cat Recipe.obtained: Ilios in the Underworld , after taking Defeat the Guild (Quest)
Cat Recipe.text: If you defeat Ivo, he will give you a powerful recipe. He is somewhere in the underworld
Cat Recipe.how: Meet Ivo in the Underworld, at the tower with a blue crystal on top and defeat his trial. In one of the previous version there was a bug, due to which you couldn't find Ivo at all. If that happens make sure you update your game. Ivo will have with him boosted: Snow Panther, Solaris and a Fire Tiger.
Cat Recipe.reward: Solaris recipe upon defeating Ivo golden Tear Topaz (100 hitpoints) upon turning the quest in

Defeat 10 Monsters.text: Go defeat 10 monsters. By the time you come back to me, you will be ready to face real challenges. I forgot to mention this earlier, but you can take up to 3 quests with you at any given time.
Defeat 10 Monsters.how: To complete this quest, go outside and fight and kill 10 different monsters. It doesn't matter which monsters.

Deliver Message.text: You need to deliver this message to the Guild in Westguard. Just travel north to Northern Alvalon and you will see the city of Westguard. You must defeat a Dragon Overlord that is blocking the way first.
Deliver Message.how: To complete this quest, simply walk past the bridge and up north into Northern Alvalon. You'll see the city of Westguard; simply walk to it. If you haven't yet defeated Arashi near the bridge, you'll have to fight it on your way. In addition, you'll have to fight Giselle right before entering the city. Here's her team: 1 Cockatrice 2 Cockatrice 3 Cockatrice
Deliver Message.reward: 271 Silver (May not be the same every time). [[Category:Corova Quests]]

Defeat the Guild.text: Attack the guilds in Westguard, Longdale, Olympia and liberate the cities. You need to do this by yourself with no assistance. We can't march into cities with a full army. It needs to be a one man mission so no civilian casualties are suffered.
Defeat the Guild.how: To complete this quest, you must leave the underworld and walk into Westguard, Longdale, and Olympia. Once reaching these cities, you will fight the guild in that city. You will first travel from Swinedene to Longdale. Here you'll fight the Longdale Guild. Longdale Guild (3 Monsters): Cockatrice x3 After defeating the Longdale Guild, you should walk south to the Olympia guild. On the way to the Olympia guild, you'll fight a few NPCs: NPC #1: Felix2. NPC #2: Ferdinand. NPC #3: Lenora. NPC #4: Cyr

Deliver Message 2.text: You need to deliver this message to the Guild in Dundean. Travel north to Ringfeld and take the path headed east. There is a powerful Dragon guarding the path. Beware.
Deliver Message 2.how: Head north one map from Westguard and then immediately east one map. Head to the town in the top right. You will then be in Dundean. Caution: There is a dragon overlord immediately south of the town.

Dangerous Cats.text: Constance is an ordinary villager, but the 3 cubs she picked up have grown into extremely dangerous monsters. We asked her to turn them in, but she refused and headed to the Cave of Earlsome. Find her.
Dangerous Cats.how: Constance appears on the 7th floor of the Cave of Earlsome. Defeat her cats to complete the quest. Constance has a Fire Tiger, a Dark Panther and a Snow Panther. All resistant to sleep/stun/paralyze effects for this fight.

Deep Whale.text: There are reports of hunters spotting a Deep Whale in the Cave of Endergate. We have not had reports of a Deep Whale for at least a few decades. Go check it out.
Deep Whale.how: Go east to Endergate and enter the Cave of Endergate. The Deep Whale is on the first floor.

Desperate Attacks.text: A famous pirate called Leomaris has just been hired by the resistance in Swinedene's fjord area. This is a desperate move by them, but it's also a deadly one. Can you handle it?
Desperate Attacks.how: Where else could a pirate be? of course all the way on the ship in Swinedene, two steps past the Ancient Relic. He welcomes you with the words: "This time, I work for a noble cause. It's very noble indeed, and I get paid for fighting Guild breeders like you. Well...what are we waiting for!" And the fight starts His army consists of 3 Tiger Swarm, Nessie, Yacare. Ceola King, 2 Dark Razorfish, Nessie, Sea Dragon, Mer King, 4 Turtle King, Tortilla and another Yacare. Oh and he just LOVES exploding

Defeat Duncan.text: A powerful breeder known as Duncan has been interrupting our missions in Saintspring. We have lost many of our best breeders...You must take revenge!.
Defeat Duncan.how: Go to the spot just above the bridge in Saintspring and head right along the cliff. Duncan will appear at the pointy end with his troops. Duncans army is small, but difficult: 2 Teddy (lv93 4,7k hp) and a Chaos Rider(lv93 5k hp), all with status immunities can be a major problem when they start spamming their paralysing gas and multi-target attacks.

Defend Olympia.text: There is an army of monsters heading towards Olympia from the southern forest. Defend Olympia!
Defend Olympia.how: Not much to explain really - beat up the monsters in the forest south of Olympia to complete this quest. If it makes any difference the monsters are led by Heloise and comprise of: Multiclops, Sphinx, Djinn, Multiclops, Guardian, Sphinx, Guardian, Multiclops, Griffin Rider, Djinn, Berith, Griffin Rider, Djinn, 2 Guardians, Juggernaut, Berith, Titan and another Berith After all that Heloise agrees to be arrested "without" resisting.

Death Crawler.text: Death Crawlers gain strength for every monster that they defeat. There is a hostile breeder on the south side of the river in Saintspring that has a powerful death crawler. Go defeat him before it's too late.
Death Crawler.how: Go to Saintspring and take 2 steps left along the southern bank of the river. Defeat Otto and his monsters there to complete the quest. Otto has a boosted level 70 Death Crawler with around 8400 hitpoints surrounded by 2 similarly booster Iron Slimes with a similar ammount near 8300 hp. If your team is not strong enough to take the crawler out with multiple target attacks it is suggested to take some monsters with anti-Metal attacks to make short work of the surrounding slugs.

Dragon Recipe.obtained: Ilios in the Underworld, after taking Cat Recipe (Quest)
Dragon Recipe.text: If you seek great power, go to the bottom of the dungeon east of here
Dragon Recipe.how: The bottom means floor 10. Waypoints every 3 floors will make it easier to get there through the powerful monsters. On the spot you'll meet a not very talkative fellow named Mathias with 3 Dreadnought (boasting a merry level 128 with over 18000 hitpoints) already waiting to give you a hard welcome. Good news - they don't have that annoying "Immune" ability, so your honed sleep, paralysis and stun-using monsters will find their ultimate use. Fun fact - Death Sentence works too if you have an Arch
Dragon Recipe.reward: Dreadnought recipe for defeating Mathias Square topaz gem (with 100 attack) upon turning the quest in for a reward [[Category:Underworld Quests]]

Evolution.text: Some monsters will evolve after gaining enough levels. Evolving your monsters is a big task for breeders. Show us that you and your monsters are capable of this.
Evolution.how: The easiest way to complete this challenge is to evolve your starter hatchling. These hatchlings evolve at a real early level: 6.
Evolution.reward: 250 Silver (May not be exactly the same each time). [[Category:Corova Quests]]

Eggxactly.obtained: Southern Alvalon from the Old Sage.
Eggxactly.how: To complete this quest, you will need to acquire every form of all four hatchlings (hatchling all the way to wyrm). You do not need to have all of these monsters in your possession, you just have to have them in your monsterpedia. You'll need to obtain some hatchlings from golden eggs in order to succeed with this quest.

Find Nemo.text: Our Ace breeder, Nemo, has gone missing. He has not reported in for over a month. He was last seen on a mission in the Cave of Endergate. Go find him.
Find Nemo.how: Look for Nemo in the area east of town, on the 14th floor of the Cave of Endergate. He won't go without a fight..actually - he won't go at all. He started noticing that the actions of the guild are a crime against people. Nemo tries to fend you off with 2 Yacare, Nessie, Tiger Swarm, 3 Turtle Kings and a Leviathan. Once more Air creatures are most effective here.
Find Nemo.reward: Nemo leaves behind him a chest with a Red Tear Emerald (58 magic). The guild rewards your victory with an Egg.

Enya.text: Enya has turned against us. She is right outside of Olympia, blocking all our activities. We need you to defeat her.
Enya.how: Not bored of seein the same old faces over and over again? Well you'll need to have a go with Enya again, there's only one spot you can exit Olympia to and she'll be waiting there. This time her arsenal includes: 2 Chimera Ants, a Terror Claw, 2 Berith, 4 Unhappy Bird, Orochi, Red Wyrm, 2 Guardian, 3 more Orochi, 2 Shogun, a Blood Rogue and another Red Wyrm

Final Battle.text: Defeat Cornelius, Xin, Raiden, Enya, Beatrice, Caius in the Sanctuary. Whatever political convictions they may have, plotting to attack a city full of civilians is not going to be tolerated. Wipe them out to end this.
Final Battle.how: There are 6 opponents you have to defeat to complete the quest, each occupying one of the first six floors of Lardon(Sanctuary). Taking the quest also seems to respawn Iago with his 3 Bone Dragons on floor 13, but it's not necessary to defeat him to progress the quest and there's no additional reward for defeating him again (the game says you unlock the Bone Dragon recipe again, but if you already have one it's just a fake message). Defeating each of them unlocks a different Dragoon or Hydra rec
Final Battle.reward: dragoon and hydra recipes Going back to a town after defeating the opponents unlocks the Unknown Relic in Swinedene Turning in the quest gives a Golden Egg This is the last quest you'll find in Olympia. If you're hungry for more head to Ilios in the Underworld through the Unknown Relic in Swinedene. [[Category:Olympia Quests]]

Head to Olympia.text: You need to head to the Holy City of Olympia as soon as possible. The road to Olympia is long, be prepared for a tough journey. Travel east to Endergate and folow the road heading south.
Head to Olympia.how: The quest will be complete when you reach Olympia. Besides the usual random encounters you can expect some static ambushes along the way (unless you've defeated them before) like Ren with 3 Shoguns on the first spot along the road in Saintspring, a cowgirl with three wolfgods just before the bridge in Saintstring and last but not least right between the bridge to Olympia and the town itself. You do not need to defeat those encounters to complete the quest, escaping from the fights is fine. Mind

Hunter.text: There have been reports of illegal hunting activities in the forest to the north of city, across the straight. Go arrest the illegal hunter.
Hunter.how: Comming from Olympia cross the bridge, take a step or two north and enter the small forest by the water. You will be attacked by Ryu. I'd say knock some sense into him, but he's hopeless, so just knock out his monsters. Those monsters are a Mage Bane, Lion King and Bastion all level 82 with about 5k hitpoints each.

Prove Yourself.text: Hmm... First, you need to prove yourself. Go outside of town and capture your 1st monster! The forest west of here would be a good place. You only get once chance per monster, so you need to lower its health in order to better your chances.
Prove Yourself.how: To complete this quest, leave the town and walk to the forest west of the town. You will immediately enter a fight. You will need to tap the card next to the monster's name to capture it, but you should weaken the monster as much as possible first.

Recipe For Creation.text: If you defeat a breeder named Ivo on the beach to the north, he will give you a recipe. You can use it to combine 2 monsters into something new. Combine Bitewing with Wolf 1 times.
Recipe For Creation.how: To complete this quest, you'll need to move north, across the bridge, and down along the beach near No Man's Castle. On the bridge you'll face your first Dragon Overlord called Arashi, if you haven't killed it already. To get to Ivo, you'll need to go down to the dock on the beach. Ivo will have this team: 1 Wolf 2 Carnoraptor 3 Wolf When you win, you'll receive a Carnoraptor Recipe .

Northern Passage.text: A breeder hostile to the Guild is blocking the passage leading north from Westguard. The Northern passage is vital for trade. Go clear it.
Northern Passage.how: To complete this quest, you'll need to walk one spot out of Westguard to the location shown below, then you'll need to defeat Christa who will fight you. {| border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" class="article-table article-table-selected" ! scope="col"| |} Christa's team is as follows: 1 Minotaur 2 Minotaur 3 Cockatrice 4 Fairy Queen

Recipe For Destruction.obtained: Southern Alvalon, from the Old Sage.
Recipe For Destruction.how: To complete this quest, you must perform every recipe combination. For all recipe combinations, see the Recipes page.

Private Army.text: Swinedene's fjord area is currently being occupied by breeders hostile to the Guild. Guy is one of them. Travel east to Endergate and then turn north to find him.
Private Army.how: Guy is on the hut area in the center of Swinedene. Like the quest says travel east from Longdale to Endergate, then follow the road north until you reach the hut. Defeat Guy to complete the quest. Guy has 21 Minotaurs. Only them, so picking fire monsters that can hit multiple targets may come in useful.

Omar.text: Another target for you in Swinedene's fjord area. Travel north to North Earlsome and head east.
Omar.how: Omar is on the hut area on the west side of Swinedene, not accessible from the main road. Like the quest says travel north from Longdale to North Earlsome, going straight north you'll run into Xuihcoatl the red wyrm dragon overlord, so you may want to take a few steps more towards the cave to avoid that spot. Defeat Omar to complete the quest. [information what monsters Omar has goes here, I can't remember anymore sorry]

Potential Danger.text: A former Special Operations Brigade member has been sighted near the fjord area in Swinedene after escaping from prison. This implies that she is cooperating with the anti-guild movement in the area.
Potential Danger.how: Travel to the spot just on the left of the central hut in Swinedene to find Heloise. Defeat her to complete the quest. Monsters to expect with Heloise: 4 Multiclopses, Griffin Rider, Berith, Griffin Rider, 3 Centurions, Juggernaut, Berith, Titan

Ninja.text: There is a Ninja in the Cave of Earlsome. We don't know what he is doing but whatever it is, we don't like it when people sniff around.
Ninja.how: The "ninja" is a girl named Chiyo, hiding on the 7th floor of the Cave of Earlsome. Go there and defeat her. Chiyo has only a level 45 Tengu, but enhanced to over 13k hitpoints.

Mythical Monsters.text: A mysterious girl has been sighted in the Cave of Endergate, carrying what seemed to be mythical creatures. Go check it out.
Mythical Monsters.how: Go east to Endergate and into the cave, all the way down to the 15th floor. The mysterious girl is called Estelle. By the time you'll get this quest the only mystery about her will probably be those tiny horns sticking out of her forehead. Estelle seems to think getting defeated is fun. Help her to it by defeating her 2 Ganeshas and Sphinx Master, all level 75.

Ray of Light (Longdale).text: A group of travellers witnessed a bright ray of light fall on a small island in Endergate. Go scout out the area, it might be a new kind of monster.
Ray of Light (Longdale).how: Go east to Endergate, cross the bridge and go around (not into) the cave and onto the small island. You'll be attacked by Kiku. The monsters she has are probably not really new to you by now: 2 Kaguya and an Archangel

Shadow.text: A Class A criminal has gone missing while being transported from Lorensia. We have reason to believe that he might be hiding somewhere in the woods of Saintspring. Your task is to track him down.
Shadow.how: Paradoxally the criminals name is indeed "Shadow" and he's lurking in the middle clump of forests on the left side of the road in Saintspring with both the reason and explanation of how he got out..not really sure which is which. Anyway Shadow has with him an annoying, but not very practically used array of 7 Megaslugs, and 7 Morfeus places interchangingly. (so Megaslug, Morfeus, Megaslug, Morfeus, Megaslug, Morfeus, Megaslug, Morfeus, Megaslug, Morfeus, Megaslug, Morfeus, Megaslug, Morfeus,

Shogun.text: A vicious criminal called Ancelote has escaped the prisons of Olympia. Go track her down. She cannot be too far from the city.
Shogun.how: You can find Ancelote one step right from the lonely hut north of Olympia. Defeat her to complete the quest. Ancelotes army is simply 14 Shoguns as the quest name suggests. A simple fight made even easier if you stock up on water creatures.

Spirited Away.text: Spirit totems are powerful tools to own. Find the creature known as Resistance in the bottom level of the cave to the north and get 1 totem from it.
Spirited Away.how: To complete this quest, you'll need to go down to the fourth floor of the North Cave. There, you'll need to search for the spirit Resistance and kill it. After killing it, you'll be able to summon Resistance in fights.

Soulstone.text: A monster's soul can be taken out and given to other monsters. It may seem cruel, but it's something a breeder must do. Create a soulstone and come back to me.
Soulstone.how: To complete this quest, you'll need to turn a monster into a soulstone. Grab a duplicate monster, then go back to a town. In the monsters section, find the duplicate and hit "Convert to Soul Stone".

Usual Suspects.obtained: Southern Alvalon, from the Old Sage.
Usual Suspects.how: To complete this quest, you must collect every monster that can be caught. This does not include monsters that can only be obtained through recipe or eggs. Look at your monsterpedia and find the monsters you don't have, then check our Monster List to match the number with the needed monster. Use our information to see if it can only be acquired through evolution or if it is catchable.
